$comment: One land attempt: two entries, one per check mode. No ref names anywhere — baseSha is a commit, testedMergeSha is the merge commit GitHub actually tested. This file is the shape the desk item renders and the lander re-verifies at merge time.

facts.$comment: The observation a merge re-checks. Recorded beside the grant so a test can assert the lander reads it rather than trusting the grant's own numbers.

assertions: no entry contains a ref name: origin/develop must not appear in this file
pr-merge entries carry testedMergeSha; head entries do not
merging 1862 requires check_suite.head_sha == testedMergeSha AND pull_requests[0].head.sha == headSha AND parents as a set == {baseSha, headSha}
the desk item renders diffstat and check state per entry, so the approval is of an artifact and not of a verdict
